title: Charm workarounds
summary: Klaudia carries three workarounds for bugs in the Charm v2 libraries. Each is marked in the code with the upstream issue. When an upstream fix ships in a release, bump the dependency, remove the workaround, and run the suite (including the e2e resize tests) to confirm. - [ ] **lipgloss: tabs expanded in multi-line strings despite `NoTabConversion`** Upstream: https://github.com/charmbracelet/lipgloss/issues/774 (filed by us, no fix yet) Workaround: the `chrome` style type in `internal/tui/tui.go` renders multi-line text one line at a time. Remove when: a lipgloss v2 release stops `getLines` rewriting tabs. `TestTabsSurviveRendering` and `TestTranscriptKeepsLiteralTabsForTheClipboard` should pass with plain `lipgloss.Style`. - [ ] **bubbletea: `tea.Println` output skips colour downsampling** Upstream: https://github.com/charmbracelet/bubbletea/issues/1709, fix in PR https://github.com/charmbracelet/bubbletea/pull/1714 (open) Workaround: `downsample` in `internal/tui/colorprofile.go`. Remove when: #1714 (or equivalent) is released. Note `inline.go` also downsamples the frames it draws itself; that part stays as long as our own renderer does. - [ ] **bubbletea: inline renderer strands frame rows when the terminal rewraps on resize** Upstream: https://github.com/charmbracelet/bubbletea/issues/1867 (our measurements are in a comment there); proposed fix https://github.com/charmbracelet/bubbletea/pull/1868 predicts the rewrap, which our tests showed fails during fast drags and on terminals that do not rewrap. Related: https://github.com/charmbracelet/bubbletea/issues/1780 (stale frame on resize) and https://github.com/charmbracelet/bubbletea/issues/431 (ExecProcess leaves the view behind). Workaround: Klaudia's own renderer, `internal/tui/inline.go`. Remove when: a bubbletea release passes `internal/tui/e2e/resize_scenario_test.go` (both drag tests, the height and streaming tests, and `TestEditorGetsTheTerminal`) with the stock renderer.
